_comment: Copy to ~/.task-console/categories.json and replace these with YOUR task names.
Every name here is synthetic. This repo is public: a real task name is real-run data and
belongs in the private machine config, never here.
A task missing from every group still shows up, under a group called 'uncategorized'.
It is never hidden, because the task nobody categorised is the one nobody is watching.

categories.name: Backup and sync
categories.desc: config and corpus into version control

categories.name: Health and governance
categories.desc: the layer that watches the other tasks
